verses.text: A song for going up to worship. I look up to the hills. Where does my help come from?
My help comes from the LORD, who made heaven and earth.
He will not let your foot slip. The one who watches over you will not fall asleep.
Look, the one who watches over Israel never gets tired and never sleeps.
The LORD watches over you. The LORD is the shade at your right side.
The sun will not harm you by day, or the moon by night.
The LORD will keep you safe from all harm. He will watch over your life.
The LORD will watch over you as you come and go, now and forever.
